description: This file implements a low-level custom printf() function with support for formatted output, including handling various data types, widths, and flags. It facilitates formatted string output primarily through the 'printf' function, utilizing a specific output mechanism via 'board_putc'.

methods.name: void printf(char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Public function for formatted output similar to standard printf, wrapping internal 'lp_Print' with variable arguments.

methods.name: void lp_Print(void (* output)(void *,char *,int),void * arg,char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: Internal function that processes the format string and arguments, producing formatted output via a callback.

methods.name: int PrintChar(char * buf,char c,int length,int ladjust)
methods.description: Helper function that formats a character with padding and justification.

methods.name: int PrintString(char * buf,char * s,int length,int ladjust)
methods.description: Helper function that formats a string with padding and justification.

methods.name: int PrintNum(char * buf,unsigned long u,int base,int negFlag,int length,int ladjust,char padc,int upcase)
methods.description: Helper function that converts a number into a string with base conversion, handling signs and padding.

methods.name: void printf_output(void * arg,char * s,int l)
methods.description: Output callback that sends formatted characters to 'board_putc', handling newline conversions.
